label: Marvel Superheroes
rubric: Powers & abilities · Cultural icon status · Story impact · Fan popularity

entries.name: Spider-Man
entries.rationale: Marvel's most recognizable hero worldwide, beloved for balancing great power with everyday struggles.

entries.name: Iron Man
entries.rationale: The genius-billionaire hero who launched the entire modern superhero movie era.

entries.name: Captain America
entries.rationale: The living symbol of Marvel's moral center, defined by unwavering conviction.

entries.name: Wolverine
entries.rationale: The clawed antihero whose brutal edge made him an instant fan favorite across decades.

entries.name: Hulk
entries.rationale: One of the most powerful beings in the Marvel universe, torn between rage and tragedy.

entries.name: Thor
entries.rationale: The God of Thunder, blending Asgardian myth with some of the franchise's biggest action.

entries.name: Black Panther
entries.rationale: King of Wakanda, whose cultural significance reached far beyond the comic-book page.

entries.name: Deadpool
entries.rationale: The fourth-wall-breaking Merc with a Mouth turned irreverence into a box-office phenomenon.

entries.name: Groot
entries.rationale: Three words and a heart of gold made this gentle giant an unlikely global favorite.

entries.name: Scarlet Witch
entries.rationale: Reality-warping power that grew from side character to one of Marvel's most formidable forces.

entries.name: Black Widow
entries.rationale: A master spy and assassin who became one of Earth's most capable non-powered heroes.

entries.name: Miles Morales
entries.rationale: A fresh, widely celebrated take on Spider-Man that expanded who gets to wear the mask.

entries.name: Rocket Raccoon
entries.rationale: A genetically engineered raccoon with a short temper and an outsized fan following.

entries.name: Storm
entries.rationale: A weather-commanding X-Man and one of the most powerful mutants ever depicted.

entries.name: Daredevil
entries.rationale: The blind Man Without Fear, patrolling Hell's Kitchen with heightened senses and grit.

entries.name: Professor X
entries.rationale: The telepathic founder of the X-Men and the moral backbone of mutantkind's fight for peace.

entries.name: Jean Grey
entries.rationale: Her transformation into the cosmic Phoenix remains one of Marvel's defining sagas.

entries.name: Star-Lord
entries.rationale: The wisecracking leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy, equal parts hero and outlaw.

entries.name: Punisher
entries.rationale: A grim vigilante whose no-mercy war on crime set him apart from Marvel's usual heroes.

entries.name: Captain Marvel
entries.rationale: One of the most powerful heroes in the cosmos, capable of standing toe-to-toe with Thanos.

entries.name: Gamora
entries.rationale: The deadliest woman in the galaxy, forged by Thanos yet defined by breaking from him.

entries.name: Hawkeye
entries.rationale: A master marksman who proves lethal even without powers among gods and monsters.

entries.name: Cyclops
entries.rationale: The disciplined field leader of the X-Men, always torn between duty and control.

entries.name: Vision
entries.rationale: A synthetic being wrestling with humanity, love, and the Mind Stone's terrible power.

entries.name: Ant-Man
entries.rationale: Proof that shrinking down can still mean thinking — and fighting — big.

entries.name: Silver Surfer
entries.rationale: The cosmic herald turned reluctant hero, wielding the Power Cosmic across the stars.

entries.name: Winter Soldier
entries.rationale: A brainwashed assassin's long road back to redemption alongside his oldest friend.

entries.name: Falcon
entries.rationale: From wingsuit-flying ally to the new Captain America, carrying the shield forward.

entries.name: She-Hulk
entries.rationale: Smart, strong, and self-aware, bringing a sharper edge of humor to gamma-powered heroics.

entries.name: Ms. Marvel
entries.rationale: A shapeshifting teenage hero whose fangirl joy reinvigorated what a Marvel hero could be.
